Name: Twilight's Shie-Esque Seven Deadly Sins

Description:
[u][size=4]DESCRIPTION:
[/size][/u][url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4264?tab=description]Shie's Portraits[/url] are my absolute favorite replacer for Stardew Valley, and I want all my mods to match! [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5209]Unlike my other mod[/url]﻿, I wanted to make replacers in Shie's style from scratch.

This is the first supported portrait replacer in this series, for the mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8324]Seven Deadly Sins
[/url]Please note: This is a replacer for [i]PORTRAITS ONLY, [/i]and does not cover the CG scenes. [i]
[/i][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]
[/url][size=2]I am currently working on requests to cover other mods as well, but I will not be covering any NPC Shie already has renders for. (Ridgeside Village is next!)[/size][u][size=4]
[/size][/u]
